en: Color photograph of a large Orthodox church with multiple green domes topped with crosses, in a historicist / neo‑Byzantine style. The church stands on a busy urban square with several red‑and‑cream buses, an older black car, cyclists, and pedestrians. Trees line the street in front of the church under a clear blue sky. The image has the grain and color palette typical of mid‑20th‑century printed postcards.
